title: Chapter 35: A Promise to go Shopping
content:
Chapter 35:

A Promise to go Shopping

Subaru was left behind in the dark.

Darkness covered his entire field of vision. He couldn’t hear a sound, couldn’t see a soul. Even if he reached out and touched something, he couldn’t even tell if it was the ground or a wall—a forced incomprehension permeated the space.

Without realizing it, he felt like his throat was trembling, letting out a scream.

Hoping it would reach far, far away, to the very edge of nothingness, he simply screamed at the top of his lungs.

“—ru.”

Suddenly, he heard a voice from beyond the darkness.

A change born within the absolute “nothingness”; he clung to it, lunging toward it.

Clawing with his hands, scrambling with his feet, heading toward the voice.

“Subaru—”

Forward, forward—!!

※※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

“To get straight to the point, your gate is the unmanageable type, Subaru, so it’s best not to push yourself.”

“Is that seriously the first thing you say after seeing me like this, you bastard?”

“Teehee.”

“That’s not cute?!”

Cursing at Puck, who floated with his arms crossed while delivering his final assessment, Subaru felt the hard, cold sensation of the grass with his entire body.

Lying face down on the grass, Subaru was gasping for air, his entire body feeling abnormally heavy. A lethargy akin to a high fever spread through him, and there was no sign of any fighting spirit reaching his limbs.

It was a familiar sensation.

Like his first day being summoned, when Puck drained his mana, or whenever Beatrice forcefully collected mana from him.

In short, Subaru was currently completely out of gas.

“For better or worse, the mesh of your gate is coarse, Subaru. So, completely ignoring the user’s intent, the contents just poured right out.”

“I told you… stop talking about me… like I’m a screen door…”

He was completely out of breath. Just how much stamina was he wasting just to spit out a single sore-loser remark?

He tried somehow to stand up, but couldn’t put strength into any part of his body; ultimately, rolling around and groaning was the best he could do.

Emilia lowered her posture to meet the gaze of Subaru, who was in such a state, and said,

“Don’t move. You’ve completely drained all the mana from your body, so just stay still. —You might not even be able to work today.”

“—That’s a problem!”

Reacting to Emilia’s attitude, which was like a mother scolding a mischievous son, Subaru instinctively let out a sharp cry.

Beside Emilia, whose eyes widened in surprise, Subaru was genuinely, seriously regretting his own carelessness.

If he really ended up wasting this entire day just like this, it meant he would be voluntarily throwing away the one day of grace he had gained in this loop.

That was too stupid. It was fatal.

Stumbling over the consequences of his own stupid actions like this was completely unacceptable.

“Nghhhh…!”

He struggled to stand, turning his anger at himself into strength.

If he could just sit up, he’d be a little better off. From there, he could gradually regain control and bounce back.

“Hey, I told you not to push yourself.”

“Now is the exact time I have to push myself. If I don’t do it now, I’ll seriously regret it for the rest of my life…”

Bringing disaster upon himself through his own actions was nothing new, but right now, the timing and situation were the absolute worst.

Seeing Subaru’s ghastly expression as he struggled, sweat beading on his forehead, Emilia gave a small shrug,

“Honestly, you’re impossible, jeez.”

She said this as she leaned down over him again.

Unable to grasp the intent behind her words, Subaru looked up at her using only his eyes,

“—? Emilia-tan, what’re you—mph!”

Meeting his gaze, she suddenly placed her hand against his upturned face. Then, the sensation of something being shoved into his mouth.

Something round, with a soft texture on his tongue.

When Subaru looked at her in confusion, Emilia nodded while keeping her palm pressed against his mouth,

“Bite down.”

“—?”

“Bite down, and swallow. One, two.”

Overwhelmed by her tone that brokered no argument, Subaru crushed the sensation in his mouth—biting down on it decisively.

Slowly, a sweet and sour taste spread through his mouth. He guessed from the texture that it was a fruit or something similar, and immediately after—it hit him.

“

Whoooooooaaaaaaa

—?!”

A heat like his entire body had been set on fire surged through him, and Subaru leaped to his feet right then and there.

His blood roared inside him as if it were boiling, and his limbs felt like they were going to burn out from pure passion down to his fingertips and the beds of his nails. His breathing grew ragged as if trying to expel the excess heat, and unable to contain the impulse, his legs started doing high knees all on their own.

But, after going that far, Subaru finally realized that he had regained the energy to stand up.

With a look of disbelief, he stared down at his own hands, opening and closing his fists to check the sensation.

The heat throughout his body hadn’t subsided yet, and he could tell his joints were still complaining of a dull lethargy. However, it wasn’t to the point where he couldn’t move.

“Wh-What was that…?”

“It’s called a bocco fruit. Eating it stimulates the mana in your body, and though it’s barely a temporary fix, your gate regains its strength.”

The identity of that familiar-sounding fruit matched what Subaru had received from an old woman living in the slums during his very first loop on his very first day.

He recalled suffering a similar ordeal after eating it back then too—though that time, Puck’s mana drain right after had saved him from the worst of it. It was like the order of events was perfectly reversed this time around.

Either way,

“Phew, what a relief. If I had gone straight into collecting a BAD ending route like that, I wouldn’t have been able to forgive myself. Emilia-tan, thank you.”

“We don’t have many of them, and it’s not good for your body, so I didn’t want to use it… How you were acting just now wasn’t a bluff, right?”

It meant that Subaru’s desperation earlier had been genuine enough to push her into using such a valuable item.

At her testing tone, Subaru raised his head,

“Of course.”

He declared without hesitation.

Then, he threw in an action of wiping his forehead,

“Still, I really acted like an idiot… If it had ended there, I would’ve died of indignation far worse than last time.”

He prided himself on piling up multiple experiences that truly no one else could, at least in terms of experiencing all sorts of ways to die, but,

“Experiencing dying from humiliation is, to be perfectly honest, a hard pass.”

In the first place, if possible, he wanted his leap to his death last time to be his final one. That too was incredibly painful, especially since he hadn’t died instantly.

Dying once is more than enough. And if possible, he’d like to face it after living out his natural lifespan on a tatami mat. Or, ideally, being watched over in Emilia’s arms after fulfilling some epically cool hero flag—.

“Just kidding. The fact that I can’t even realistically imagine that happening is proof of what a small fry I am.”

Even in a joke, it didn’t seem like he could speak of Death lightly anymore.

Being able to laugh at this as him just getting cowardly was something no one could do, except someone who had gone through the exact same experiences as Subaru in the truest sense.

He rotated his torso, checking his condition once again.

He was far from top form; in fact, he was in a state that left him anxious about various parts of his body.

But Subaru didn’t have the luxury to postpone his plans just because of that.

“Are you okay? Do you think you can handle your work?”

“I’ll do my work, and I’ll see everything else through, too. Just think of yourself as riding aboard the Unsinkable Ship Subaru Mk-II, Emilia-tan, and leave it all to me.”

“For an unsinkable ship, it’s already had to be revamped once...”

Being called out on that completely erased any sense of reassurance.

In all honesty, he had sunk not once but about seven times, but there was absolutely no need to point that out and ruin the morning mood. Subaru just took note.

Pretending he hadn’t heard Emilia’s remark, Subaru did some knee bends on the spot to get his head back in the game,

“Alright then, time to face my seniors with a fresh mindset!”

“Right. You haven’t said anything to the two of them since yesterday, Subaru…”

“—Ah.”

Being told that right as he was stretching his back, his lower back let out a dull pop.

※※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

“Sister, sister. A heartless ingrate named Subaru has arrived.”

“Rem, Rem. A wage thief known as Barusu has appeared.”

“I am so, so sorry about yesterday! So please forgive me, I’m begging you!”

Bowing his head, he groveled and begged for forgiveness.

Somehow, it felt like he had been doing nothing but bowing in apology for the past twelve hours. Except for Roswaal, he had expressed that sentiment to everyone in the mansion, achieving a full completion of the female cast.

“I’ve finished clearing the route where girls look down on me in disgust—my karma’s running deep.”

“Sister, sister. Subaru is a massive pervert.”

“Rem, Rem. Barusu is a despicable masochist.”

“You’re taking it too far, especially you, Sister!”

Shouting this while still performing the Japanese ultimate technique, DOGEZA, Subaru used his arms as a pivot from that posture to transition into a handstand, twisting his body and standing up in a fluid motion,

“Anyway, sorry for being a pathetic mess yesterday, and super annoying the day before… Well, a lot happened and I was feeling pretty beat down, but I’m turning over a new leaf. From today on, I’m going as the New Subaru.”

“A lap pillow, was it.”

“A lap pillow, wasn’t it.”

“Does absolutely everybody know about that, how embarrassing?!”

An action of pure humiliation, covering his face. As Subaru crumpled to the ground, the twin maids exchanged glances,

“Shall we begin our morning duties, Sister?”

“It’s about time we started our morning chores, Rem.”

“Giving me a ‘no comment’ is depressing in its own way, you know!”

The two of them casually sliced Subaru’s comment in half with a wave of their hands.

Ignoring Subaru, who reacted by sticking out his tongue and going “Ouch!”, they briskly prepared to split up and get straight to work. Just then,

“Time out, time out. I’ve got a little favor to ask before we start the morning work.”

Stopping in their tracks at Subaru’s call, the two turned back and tilted their heads in unison,

“A favor?”

“A bother?”

“I’m interacting with you guys with a calm heart for the first time in a while, yet what is this feeling bubbling up in my chest… human beings are so mysterious.”

As much as he was happy to be able to exchange this kind of banter, unlike her younger sister, the elder sister openly scowled in a way that made his wry smile twitch.

He sighed, lightly brushing off the anger at this absurdity welling up within him,

“Actually, I’d like to go to the village. It’s nearby, right? Do you happen to have any plans to go grocery shopping or anything?”

To confirm the theory he’d come up with in the Forbidden Library last night, he wanted to visit the village sometime today. At Subaru’s ulterior motive, Rem placed a hand on her chin,

“Rem believes our spices are running a bit low, so she was planning to go to the village tomorrow, but…”

“Then how about moving that schedule up to today? If we’re running out, the sooner the better, and it’s not exactly the kind of environment where we can just casually pop over to the neighbor’s to borrow some miso if we run out of spices, right?”

Even if they wanted to be neighborly, there were no neighboring mansions in the first place.

Rem seemed to ponder Subaru’s proposal a little.

However,

“That should be fine, shouldn’t it?”

“Sister?”

The one who responded so nonchalantly in place of her pondering younger sister was Ram, lightly touching her peach-colored hair while closing one eye.

She directed her gaze at her sister’s questioning voice,

“We have to go shopping anyway, and there’s no urgent business. We also have a Barusu to be the heavy-lifter, so we might as well use this opportunity to work him to the bone.”

“Please at least take into consideration the fact that I actually had my stomach sliced open and am recovering from a three-day convalescence!”

Throwing that retort at Ram’s rather blunt opinion, Subaru couldn’t help but inwardly tilt his head at her covering fire.

Because, getting down to it, it seemed like the twin maids’ opinions weren’t unified at this point.

Considering the situations of the previous loop and the loop before that, as long as the conditions were met, both twin maids should be in a position where they take on the role of disposing of Subaru.

The fact that their opinions were divided was a sense of incongruity that Subaru, who had actually experienced being murdered by them, could not overlook.

In any case, having covering fire was genuinely appreciated.

After all, Subaru had fully intended to seriously rack his brain on how to persuade the two of them.

“…If you say so, Sister.”

After a brief moment of silent contemplation, Rem also gave a positive reply.

Though Rem often took the initiative in action, from his interactions with them so far, he knew she fundamentally prioritized her older sister’s opinions.

The moment he managed to win Ram over, even if by chance, one could say the outcome of this negotiation was already decided.

Toward Subaru, who was secretly pumping his fist, Rem erased her previously thoughtful expression, replacing it with a composed face,

“However, our trip to the village will be after lunch regardless. After the second hour of Brightsun—let us at least finish our regular chores by 

then.”

1

“It’s alright. Barusu, who proposed it, will work himself to the bone. Right?”

“I’d really appreciate it if the older sister who agreed with me pitched in, too, though… Well, I’ll give it my blood, sweat and whatsit...”

““Tears.””

“Yeah, gonna do that.”

Corrected on his fill-in-the-blank sentence in stereo sound, Subaru responded while scratching his head. Thus, the negotiation bore magnificent fruit.

The promise for the shopping trip secured, it was finally time to start the servant grind. Rem began walking briskly, sorting things out in her head, perhaps reorganizing the day’s schedule to include the shopping trip.

Seeing off the blue-haired girl, Subaru looked at the pink-haired girl beside him. She had been selected as Subaru’s overseer again today, and he would be accompanying her to learn the ropes of his unaccustomed servant life.

Yesterday—or rather, the day before, to be exact; it was safer to avoid dealing with her with that weird energy he had that day. Or rather, with his headspace having come full circle, now giving him the leeway to look back on himself, it was just too painful and imitating it was impossible.

“Becoming aware of my own dark past in such a short amount of time is scary. I’m in a state of pseudo-post-nut clarity right now… Well, no use talking about it, time to get to work, right, Senpai?”

“Before that.”

Just as he was about to start walking, Ram stopped him, returning the favor from earlier. He stuck out the foot he was about to step forward with to the side, turning around to look at her in a bowlegged stance.

Ram crossed her arms and looked up at Subaru from below, saying,

“About that magic in the garden earlier…”

“Yeah, sorry for being so pathetic. It’s completely useless. I’m going to seal that away for a while. Specifically, he says it takes twenty years to master!”

“It’s true that it was pathetic, but please don’t agitate Rem too much.”

“—?”

Unable to understand what Ram meant, a question mark popped up in Subaru’s head.

Seeing his blank expression, Ram scoffed “Hah,” through her nose like she sometimes did,

“Disrupting a corner of the garden, including Lady Emilia, with Shamak—Barusu, you ought to dedicate a dance of gratitude to Ram for stopping Rem.”

“Ah… ah-ah, ah, right, right, totally.”

He’d been too shocked by his magic failure to notice, but from an outsider’s perspective, he supposed it wouldn’t be entirely impossible for it to look like “that kind of situation.”

In that sense, he was truly grateful to Ram for not jumping the gun. On the flip side, Rem’s tendency to jump to conclusions and act on them gave him the chills.

“Man, I seriously can’t afford to be careless… I’ve used four continues and this is where I’m at. I’m really worried about my future here.”

“What are you muttering about… if we don’t start working soon, we won’t make it in time for breakfast or lunch.”

“Yes, yes. No, look, I was just thinking about the shopping trip this afternoon. I was wondering which of you would be accompanying me.”

Considering his current mental exhaustion, having Rem tag along made his heart heavy.

Even so, considering his objective in the village, Rem was actually the more fitting companion. Since he didn’t know the conditions dictating whether Ram or Rem would come with him to the village, he had asked the question partly to feel out the situation—

“Just what stupid things are you saying?”

“Huh?”

At Subaru tilting his head, Ram uncharacteristically broke her expressionless face into a smile.

Into an incredibly wicked, bone-chilling smile.

“Ram and Rem, we will both be going. A flower in each hand, as they say, Barusu.”

—I sure hope those flowers aren’t poisonous.

Having not considered how things would unfold if the negotiations went a little too well, Subaru covered his face with his hand, looked up at the ceiling, and simply muttered that in his heart.
